exposure: Transversus Abdominis Plane (TAP) block with bupivacaine and clonidine
Local wound infiltration with bupivacaine and clonidine
cohort: One hundred women aged 18-35 years, ASA physical status I or II, who had undergone a lower segment caesarean section.
finding: TAP block was more effective than local wound infiltration in reducing postoperative pain (VAS scores 2-6 hours) and the overall amount of rescue analgesics required after caesarean section.
